translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( kay ghazab ) say daro . yaqeen jano kay qayamat ka bhonchal bari zabardast cheez hai .

jiss din woh tumhen nazar aajaye ga , uss din her doodh pilaney wali uss bacchay ( tak ) ko bhool bethay gi , jiss ko uss ney doodh pilaya , aur her hamal wali apna hamal gira bethay gi , aur log tumhen yun nazar ayen gay kay woh nashay mein bad-hawas hain , halankay woh nashay mein nahi hon gay , balkay Allah ka azab bara sakht hoga .
aur logon  mein kuch aesay hain jo Allah kay baaray mein bey janey boojhay jhagray kertay hain , aur uss sarkash shetan kay peechay chal kharray hotay hain .
jiss kay muqaddar mein yeh likh diya gaya hai kay jo koi ussay dost banaye ga , to woh uss ko gumrah keray ga , aur ussay bharakti dozakh kay azab ki taraf ley jaye ga .

aey logo ! agar tumhen dobara zinda honey kay baaray mein kuch shak hai to ( zara socho kay ) hum ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya ,   phir nutfay say , phir aik jamay huye khoon say , phir aik gosht kay loathray say jo ( kabhi ) poora ban jata hai , aur ( kabhi ) poora nahi banta ,   takay hum tumharay liye ( tumhari ) haqeeqat khol ker bata den , aur hum ( tumhen ) maon kay pet mein jab tak chahtay hain , aik mutayyan mauddat tak thehraye rakhtay hain , phir tumhen aik bacchay ki shakal mein bahir latay hain , phir ( tumhen paaltay hain ) takay tum apni bharpoor umar tak phonch jao , aur tum mein say baaz woh hain jo ( pehlay hi ) duniya say utha liye jatay hain , aur tumhi mein say baaz woh hotay hain jinn ko bad-tareen umar ( yani intehai burhapay ) tak loata diya jata hai , yahan tak kay woh sabb kuch janney kay baad bhi kuch nahi jantay .   aur tum dekhtay ho kay zameen murjhai hoi parri hai , phir jab hum uss per paani barsatay hain to woh harkat mein aati hai , uss mein barhotry hoti hai , aur woh her qisam ki khushnuma cheezen ugati hai .
yeh sabb kuch iss wajeh say hai kay Allah hi ka wajood bar-haq hai ,   aur wohi bey janon mein jaan daalta hai , aur woh her cheez per mukammal qudrat rakhta hai ,
aur iss liye kay qayamat ki gharri aaney wali hai , jiss mein koi shak nahi hai , aur iss liye kay Allah unn sabb logon  ko dobara zinda keray ga jo qabron mein hain .
aur logon  mein kuch aesay hain jo Allah kay baaray mein jhagray kertay hain , halankay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat , aur naa koi roshni denay wali kitab .

woh takabbur say apna pehlo akarraye huye hain , takay doosron ko bhi Allah kay raastay say gumrah keren . aesay hi shaks kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai , aur qayamat kay din hum ussay jalti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .
. ( kay ) yeh sabb kuch teray uss kartoot ka badla hai jo tu ney apney haathon say aagay bheja tha , aur yeh baat tey hai kay Allah bandon per zulm dhaaney wala nahi hai .

aur logon  mein woh shaks bhi hai jo aik kinaray per reh ker Allah ki ibadat kerta hai . chunacheh agar ussay ( duniya mein ) koi faeeda phonch gaya to woh uss say mutmaeen hojata hai , aur agar ussay koi aazmaesh paish aagae to woh mun morr ker ( phir kufr ki taraf ) chal deta hai .   aesay shaks ney duniya bhi khoi , aur aakhirat bhi . yehi to khula huwa ghaata hai .
woh Allah ko chorr ker unn ki ibadat kerta hai jo naa ussay nuqsan phoncha saktay hain , naa koi faeeda dey saktay hain . yehi to perlay darjay ki gumrahi hai .
yeh aesay ( jhootay khuda ) ko pukartay hain jiss ka nuqsan uss kay faeeday say ziyada qareeb hai .   aisa madadgaar bhi kitna bura hai , aur aisa sathi bhi kitna bura !

jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah yaqeenan unn ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , yaqeenan Allah her woh kaam kerta hai jiss ka irada kerleta hai .

jo shaks yeh samajhta tha kay Allah duniya aur aakhirat mein iss ( payghumber ) ki madad nahi keray ga to woh aasman tak aik rassi taan ker rabta kaat daalay , phir dekhay kay kiya uss ki yeh tadbeer uss ki jhunjhulahat door ker-sakti hai ?
aur hum ney iss ( Quran ) ko khuli khuli nishaniyon ki soorat mein issi tarah utaara hai , aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai , hidayat deta hai .

bilashuba momin hon ya yahudi , saabi hon ya nasrani aur majoosi , ya woh jinhon ney shirk ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah qayamat kay din inn sabb kay darmiyan faisla keray ga . yaqeenan Allah her cheez ka gawah hai .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah kay aagay woh sabb sajda kertay hain jo aasmano mein hain aur woh sabb jo zameen mein hain ,   neez sooraj aur chaand , aur sitaray aur pahar , aur darkht aur janwer , aur boht say insan bhi ! aur boht say aesay bhi hain jinn per azab tey hochuka hai . aur jissay Allah zaleel kerday , koi nahi hai jo ussay izzat dey sakay . yaqeenan Allah wohi kerta hai jo chahta hai .

yeh ( momin aur kafir ) do fareeq hain jinhon ney apney perwerdigar kay baaray mein aik doosray say jhagrra kiya hai . abb ( iss ka faisla iss tarah hoga kay ) jinn logon  ney kufr apnaya hai , unn kay liye aag kay kapray tarashey jayen gay . unn kay saron kay oopper say kholta huwa paani chorra jaye ga .
jiss say unn kay pet kay andar ki cheezen aur khalen gal jayen gi .
aur unn kay liye lohey kay hathoray hon gay .
jab kabhi takleef say tang aa-ker woh iss/uss say nikalna chahen gay , to enhen/unhen phir ussi/issi mein loata diya jaye ga , kay chakho jalti aag ka maza !

. ( doosri taraf ) jo log emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik kaam kiye hain , Allah unn ko aesi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay say nehren behti hon gi , jahan unhen soney kay kangganon aur motiyon say sajaya jaye ga , aur jahan unn ka libas resham hoga .
aur ( wajeh yeh hai kay ) inn logon  ki rasai pakeezah baat ( yani kalma toheed ) tak hogaee thi , aur woh uss khuda kay raastay tak phonch gaye thay jo her tareef ka mustahiq hai .

beyshak woh log ( saza kay laeeq hain ) jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai , aur jo doosron ko Allah kay raastay say aur uss masjid-e-haram say roktay hain jissay hum ney logon  kay liye aisa banaya hai kay uss mein wahan kay bashinday aur bahir say aaney walay sabb barabar hain .   aur jo koi shaks uss mein zulm ker kay tairrhi raah nikalay ga ,   hum ussay dardnak azab ka maza chakhayen gay .

aur yaad kero woh waqt jab hum ney Ibrahim ko iss ghar ( yani khana kaaba ) ki jagah bata di thi ,   ( aur yeh hidayat di thi kay : )  meray sath kissi ko shareek naa thehrana , aur meray ghar ko unn logon  kay liye pak rakhna jo ( yahan ) tawaf keren , aur ibadat kay liye kharray hon , aur rukoo sajday baja layen .

aur logon  mein hajj ka aelaan kerdo , kay woh tumharay paas pedal ayen , aur door daraz kay raaston say safar kernay wali unn oontniyon per sawar ho ker ayen jo ( lambay safar say ) dubli hogaee hon ,

takay woh unn fawaeed ko aankhon say dekhen jo unn kay liye rakhay gaye hain , aur mutayyan dino mein unn chopayo per Allah ka naam len jo Allah ney unhen ata kiye hain .    chunacheh ( musalmano ! ) unn janweron mein say khud bhi khao , aur tang dast mohtaj ko bhi khilao .
phir ( hajj kernay walay ) logon  ko chahiye kay woh apna mail kuchail door keren , aur apni mannaten poori keren , aur iss bait-e-ateeq ka tawaf keren .

yeh sari baaten yaad rakho , aur jo shaks inn cheezon ki taazeem keray ga jinn ko Allah ney hurmat di hai , to uss kay haq mein yeh amal uss kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek boht behtar hai . saray maweshi tumharay liye halal kerdiye gaye hain , siwaye unn janweron kay jinn ki tafseel tumhen parh ker suna di gaee hai .   lehaza button ki gandagi say aur jhooti baat say iss tarah bach ker raho .

kay tum yaksoi kay sath Allah ki taraf rukh kiye huye ho , uss kay sath kissi ko shareek naa mantay ho . aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehraye to goya woh aasman say gir parra , phir ya to perinday ussay uchak ley jayen , ya hawa ussay kahen door daraz ki jagah laa phenkay .
yeh sari baaten yaad rakho , aur jo shaks Allah kay shaaeer ki taazeem keray , to yeh baat dilon kay taqwa say hasil hoti hai .
tumhen aik moyyan waqt tak inn ( janweron say ) fawaeed hasil kernay ka haq hai ,   phir inn kay halal honey ki manzil ussi qadeem ghar ( yani khana kaaba ) kay aas paas hai .

aur hum ney her ummat kay liye qurbani iss gharz kay liye muqarrar ki hai kay woh unn maweshiyon per Allah ka naam len jo Allah ney unhen ata farmaye hain . lehaza tumhara khuda bus aik hi khuda hai , chunacheh tum ussi ki farmanbardaari kero , aur khushkhabri suna do unn logon  ko jinn kay dil Allah kay aagay jhukay huye hain ,

jinn ka haal yeh hai kay jab unn kay samney Allah ka ziker kiya jata hai to unn kay dilon per roab taari hojata hai , aur jo apney oopper parrney wali her museebat per sabar kernay walay hain , aur namaz ko qaeem kernay walay hain , aur jo rizq hum ney unhen diya hai , uss mein say ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kertay hain .

aur qurbani kay oont aur gaye ko hum ney tumharay liye Allah kay shaaeer mein shamil kiya hai , tumharay liye unn mein bhalai hai . chunacheh jab woh aik qatar mein kharray hon , unn per Allah ka naam lo , phir jab ( zibah hoker ) unn kay pehlo zameen per gir-jayen to unn ( kay gosht ) mein say khud bhi khao , aur unn mohtajon ko bhi khilao jo sabar say bethay hon , aur unn ko bhi jo apni hajat zahir keren .   aur unn janweron ko hum ney issi tarah tumharay tabey bana diya hai takay tum shukar guzaar bano .

Allah ko naa unn ka gosht phonchta hai , naa unn ka khoon , lekin uss kay paas tumhara taqwa phonchta hai . uss ney yeh janwer issi tarah tumharay tabey bana diye hain , takay tum iss baat per Allah ki takbeer kero kay uss ney tumhen hidayat ata farmaee . aur jo log khush asloobi say naik amal kertay hain , unhen khushkhabri suna do .
beyshak Allah unn logon  ka difaa keray ga jo emaan ley aaye hain .   yaqeen jano kay Allah kissi dagha baaz nashukray ko pasand nahi kerta .

jinn logon  say jang ki jarahi hai , unhen ijazat di jati hai ( kay woh apney difaa mein larren ) kiyonkay unn per zulm kiya gaya hai ,   aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah unn ko fatah dilaney per poori tarah qadir hai .

yeh woh log hain jinhen sirf itni baat per apney gharon say nahaq nikala gaya hai kay unhon ney yeh kaha tha kay humara perwerdigar Allah hai . aur agar Allah logon  kay aik giroh ( kay sharr ) ko doosray kay zariye dafa naa kerta rehta to khanqahen aur kaleesa aur ibadat gaahen aur masjiden jinn mein Allah ka kasrat say ziker kiya jata hai , sabb mismaar kerdi jaten .   aur Allah zaroor unn logon  ki madad keray ga jo uss ( kay deen ) ki madad keren gay . bilashuba Allah bari quooat wala , baray iqtidar wala hai .

yeh aesay log hain kay agar hum enhen zameen mein iqtidar bakhshen to woh namaz qaeem keren , aur zakat ada keren , aur logon  ko naiki ki takeed keren , aur burai say roken .   aur tamam kamon ka anjam Allah hi kay qabazay mein hai .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) agar yeh log tumhen jhutlatay hain , to inn say pehlay nooh ki qoam , aur aad o samood ki qoamen bhi ( apney apney payghumberon ko ) jhutla chuki hain ,
neez Ibrahim ki qoam aur loot ki qoam
aur madiyan kay log bhi . aur musa ko bhi jhutlaya gaya tha , chunacheh unn kafiron ko mein ney kuch dheel di , phir unhen pakar mein ley liya , abb dekh lo kay meri pakar kaisi thi !

gharz kitni bastiyan then jinn ko hum ney uss waqt halak kiya jab woh zulm ker rahi then , chunacheh woh apni chatton kay ball giri parri hain , aur kitney hi kunaen jo abb beykaar huye parray hain , aur kitney pakay banay huye mehal ( jo khanndar ban chukay hain ) .

tu kiya yeh log zameen mein chalay phiray nahi hain jiss say unhen woh dil hasil hotay jo unhen samajh dey saktay , ya aesay kaan hasil hotay jinn say woh sunn saktay-? haqeeqat yeh hai kay aankhen andhi nahi hoten , balkay woh dil andhay hojatay hain jo seenon kay andar hain .

aur yeh log tum say azab jaldi laney ka mutalba kertay hain , halankay Allah apney waday ki hergiz khilaf warzi nahi keray ga , aur yaqeen jano kay tumharay rab kay yahan ka aik din tumhari ginti kay mutabiq aik hazar saal ki tarah ka hota hai .
aur kitni hi bastiyan aesi then jinhen mein ney mohlat di thi , aur woh zulm kerti rahen , phir mein ney unhen pakar mein ley liya , aur sabb ko aakhir kaar meray paas hi loattna hoga .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay :  aey logo ! mein to tumhen wazahat kay sath khabrdar kernay wala hun .
phir jo log emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal kernay lagay , to unn kay liye maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq hai .
aur jinn logon  ney humari nishaniyon ko neecha dikhaney kay liye dorr dhoop ki hai , to woh dozakh kay baasi hain .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney jab bhi koi Rasool ya nabi bheja to uss kay sath yeh waqiaa zaroor huwa kay jab uss ney ( Allah ka kalam ) parha to shetan ney uss kay parhney kay sath hi ( kuffaar kay dilon mein ) koi rukawat daal di , phir jo rukawat shetan daalta hai , Allah ussay door ker deta hai , phir apni aayaton ko ziyada mazboot ker deta hai ,   aur Allah baray ilm ka , bari hikmat ka malik hai .

yeh ( shetan ney rukawat iss liye daali ) takay jo rukawat shetan ney daali thi , Allah ussay unn logon  kay liye fitna bana dey jinn kay dilon mein rog hai , aur jinn kay dil sakht hain . aur yaqeen jano kay yeh zalim log mukhalifat mein boht door chalay gaye hain .

aur ( uss rukawat ko Allah taalaa ney iss liye door kiya ) takay jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh jaan len kay yehi ( kalam ) bar-haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , phir woh uss per emaan layen , aur unn kay dil uss kay aagay jhuk jayen . aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah emaan walon ko seedhay raastay ki hidayat denay wala hai .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh iss ( kalam ) ki taraf say barabar shak hi mein parray rahen gay , yahan tak kay unn per achanak qayamat aajaye , ya aesay din ka azab unn tak aa-phonchay jo ( unn kay liye ) kissi bhalai ko janam denay ki salahiyat say khaali hoga .
badshahi uss din Allah ki hogi , woh unn kay darmiyan faisla keray ga , chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , woh naimaton kay baaghaat mein hon gay .
aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai , to aesay logon  kay liye zillat wala azab hoga .

aur jinn logon  ney Allah kay raastay mein hijrat ki , phir qatal kerdiye gaye ya unn ka intiqal hogaya , to Allah unhen zaroor acha rizq dey ga , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah hi behtareen rizq denay wala hai .
woh unhen zaroor aesi jagah phonchaye ga jiss say woh khush hojayen gay , aur Allah yaqeenan her baat janney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

yeh baat to tey hai , aur ( aagay yeh bhi sunn lo kay ) jiss shaks ney kissi ko badlay mein itni hi takleef phonchai jitni uss ko phonchai gaee thi , uss kay baad phir uss say ziyadti ki gaee , to Allah uss ki zaroor madad keray ga .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah boht moaaf kernay wala , boht bakhshney wala hai .
yeh iss liye kay Allah ( ki qudrat itni bari hai kay woh ) raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai ,   aur iss liye kay Allah her baat sunta , her cheez dekhta hai .
yeh iss liye kay Allah hi haq hai , aur yeh log ussay chorr ker jinn cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain , woh sabb batil hain , aur Allah hi woh hai jiss ki shaan bhi oonchi hai , rutba bhi bara .
kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney aasman say paani utaara , jiss say zameen sarsabz hojati hai ? haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah bara meharban , her baat say ba-khabar hai .
jo kuch aasmano mein hai , aur jo kuch zameen mein hai , sabb ussi ka hai . aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah hi woh zaat hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah ney zameen ki sari cheezen tumharay kaam mein laga rakhi hain , aur woh kashtiyan bhi jo uss kay hukum say samandar mein chalti hain-? aur uss ney aasman ko iss tarah thaam rakha hai kay woh uss ki ijazat kay baghair zameen per nahi gir sakta . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  kay sath shafqat ka bartao kernay wala , bara meharban hai .
aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zindagi di , phir woh tumhen moat dey ga , phir tumhen zinda keray ga . waqaee insan bara nashukra hai .

hum ney her ummat kay logon  kay liye ibadat ka aik tareeqa muqarrar kiya hai , jiss kay mutabiq woh ibadat kertay hain ,   lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) logon  ko tum say iss moamlay mein jhagrra nahi kerna chahiye , aur tum apney perwerdigar ki taraf dawat detay raho . tum yaqeenan seedhay raastay per ho .
aur agar woh tum say jhagrren to keh do kay :  jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , Allah ussay khoob janta hai .
Allah qayamat kay din tumharay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein tum ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .
kiya tum nahi jantay kay aasman aur zameen ki tamam cheezen Allah kay ilm mein hain-? yeh sabb baaten aik kitab mein mehfooz hain . beyshak yeh saray kaam Allah kay liye boht aasaan hain .

aur yeh log Allah ko chorr ker unn cheezon ki ibadat kertay hain jinn ( kay mabood honey ) ki Allah ney koi daleel nazil nahi ki , aur khud inn logon  ko bhi uss kay baaray mein koi ilm hasil nahi .   aur inn zalimon ka ( aakhirat mein ) koi madadgaar nahi hoga .

aur jab inn ko humari aayaten apni poori wazahaton kay sath parh ker sunai jati hain , to tum inn kafiron kay chehron per nagawari kay asraat saaf pehchan letay ho , aisa lagta hai kay yeh unn logon  per hamla kerden gay jo enhen humari aayaten parh ker suna rahey hain . keh do kay :  logo ! kiya mein tumhen aesi cheez batla dun jo iss say ziyada nagawar hai ?   aag ! Allah ney kafiron say iss ka wada ker rakha hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

logo ! aik misal biyan ki jarahi hai abb ussay kaan laga ker suno ! tum log Allah ko chorr ker jinn jinn ko dua kay liye pukartay ho , woh aik makkhi bhi peda nahi ker-saktay , chahye iss kaam kay liye sabb kay sabb ikatthay hojayen , aur agar makkhi unn say koi cheez cheen ker lay jaye to woh uss say churra bhi nahi saktay . aisa dua maangney wala bhi boda aur jiss say dua maangi jarahi hai woh bhi !
inn logon  ney Allah ki theek theek qadar hi nahi pehchani . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah quooat ka bhi malik hai , iqtidar ka bhi malik .
Allah farishton mein say bhi apna paygham phonchaney walay muntakhib kerta hai , aur insanon mein say bhi .   yaqeenan Allah her baat sunta her cheez dekhta hai .
woh unn kay aagay aur peechay ki sari baaton ko janta hai , aur Allah hi per tamam moamlaat ka daromadar hai .
aey emaan walo ! rukoo kero , aur sajda kero , aur apney perwerdigar ki bandagi kero , aur bhalai kay kaam kero , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .

aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero , jaisa kay jihad ka haq hai .   uss ney tumhen ( apney deen kay liye ) muntakhib kerliya hai , aur tum per deen kay moamlay mein koi tangi nahi rakhi . apney baap Ibrahim kay deen ko mazbooti say thaam lo , uss ney pehlay bhi tumhara naam muslim rakha tha , aur iss ( Quran ) mein bhi , takay yeh Rasool tumharay liye gawah banen , aur tum doosray logon  kay liye gawah bano .   lehaza namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah ko mazbooti say thamay rakho , woh tumhara rakhwala hai , dekho , kitna acha rakhwala , aur kitna acha madadgaar !
